name: Neo – Store Insights
author: neo

sections.description:
Neo – Store Insights connects your WooCommerce store to Neo by Nethority. After you activate it, the plugin connects itself and keeps your sales flowing in. Nothing to configure.

  • Connects automatically and retries on its own until it works.
  • Sends the daily figures of your past orders (up to two years) in the background.
  • Real-time updates when an order is created, changed or refunded.
  • A nightly sync that also catches up if a night is missed.

Each day is sent as a whole, so figures are never counted twice.

External services

This plugin sends your store’s daily sales figures (orders, sales, discounts, taxes, refunds, customer counts) and its name, currency and time zone to Neo at https://portal.nethority.com. It creates a read-only WooCommerce REST API key for Neo, so that Neo can check the store is yours. Nethority’s terms: https://nethority.com/terms-and-conditions/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. That is all. Open the Neo menu in the WordPress admin to see the connection and import progress.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Renamed to Neo – Store Insights and connects to Neo.
  • Fixed: the connection, schedules and first import did not start on activation.
  • The first import and the nightly sync now send daily figures, in background batches.
  • Removed two admin callbacks that could change the store’s API key without a login.
